summary: Iteration 46 — Benchmark Workouts (Parts 1-5) fully verified end-to-end. BACKEND (13/13 pytest pass, /app/backend/tests/test_benchmark.py, /app/test_reports/pytest/iter46.xml): (a) Auth gating — GET /api/benchmark/profile, GET /api/benchmark/results, POST /api/benchmark/sessions all return 401/403 without a bearer token. (b) Empty-state profile — /api/benchmark/profile returns exactly the 9 required keys (ftp, ftpWkg, fiveMinPower, oneMinPower, sprintPower, aerobicEfficiency, preferredCadence, recoveryResponse, lastBenchmarkDate) with every value === null (NEVER zero) for the freshly-tested GL account, so UI can render 'Not yet tested' honestly. (c) Empty-state results — /api/benchmark/results returns {results: []}. (d) Sessions CRUD — POST with a full readiness payload returns {id, startedAt, testId, status:'in_progress', readinessAnswers, readiness}, and _id/user_id are stripped; GET /api/benchmark/sessions/{id} returns it; PATCH updates status and the change is reflected on GET. Missing testId → 400; unknown session id on GET/PATCH → 404. Do-Not-Start readiness payload is stored verbatim with readiness.status='do_not_start'. (e) User scoping — a freshly-registered temp account cannot GET the GL session (404), sees profile with all 9 null values, and results:[]. Temp account is DELETEd after use. FRONTEND (landscape 1280x900 real GL login via email-input/password-input/submit-btn, no mocks): (Part 1) Side nav order captured via [data-testid^=railnav-]: home, workouts, routes, BENCHMARK, training, progress, community, wellness, connections, settings, help — 'routes' index=2 < 'benchmark' index=3 < 'training' index=4. Clicking railnav-benchmark routes to /benchmark. Settings/Help remain at the bottom via navFooter. (Part 2) /benchmark landing renders bm-profile with EXACTLY 9 'Not yet tested' occurrences (0 zeros in the innerText). rec-view → /benchmark/ramp, rec-schedule → renders the 'Scheduling arrives with the training-calendar integration.' notice inline, rec-start → /benchmark/readiness/ramp. bm-recent-empty visible with tracking copy. hist-range-4Weeks/3Months/6Months/12Months/AllTime all present and selectable, chart placeholder Ionicon+copy rendered. (Part 3) bm-library card is on the landing AND standalone /benchmark/library screen; all 8 test cards render (bm-start-ramp, twenty_min_ftp, five_min_aerobic, one_min_power, sprint_power, aerobic_efficiency, cadence_control, recovery_response) each paired with bm-view-<id>. Filters lib-filter-all/threshold/aerobic_power/short_power/endurance/technique/recovery/maximal/submaximal/no_power all rendered. Filtering behaviour verified: submaximal→[aerobic_efficiency, cadence_control, recovery_response] (3 cards); threshold→[ramp, twenty_min_ftp] (2 cards); all→all 8. (Part 4) /benchmark/ramp reusable detail template renders with detail-start (→ /benchmark/readiness/ramp), detail-schedule (notice) and detail-home (→ /benchmark). Detail template is data-driven from catalog.ts so the other 7 test-detail pages share the same shell. (Part 5 — SAFETY-CRITICAL): /benchmark/readiness/ramp shows 7 questions (well, symptoms, illness, hard_workout, sleep, fuelled, setup) with rd-<qid>-yes / rd-<qid>-no chips and a 0/7 progress meter that updates as chips are tapped. rd-check has aria-disabled='true' until all 7 are answered. SCENARIO A (all ideal): outcome=rd-outcome-ready with rd-continue present, ONE POST /api/benchmark/sessions fired. SCENARIO B (symptoms=yes, others ideal): outcome=rd-outcome-do_not_start; rd-continue is CORRECTLY ABSENT (safety gate intact); rd-exit and rd-submax present; POST /api/benchmark/sessions fired persisting the danger answer; rd-submax navigates to /benchmark/library?filter=submaximal (URL param passes through). SCENARIO C (hard_workout=yes, no danger): outcome=rd-outcome-caution with rd-continue + rd-another + rd-reschedule all present; POST fired; rd-another navigates to /benchmark/library. No JS errors on any screen. No red-screen. No mocked APIs.
action_items: None — Parts 1-5 verified end-to-end. Feature is production-ready. Safety gating (do_not_start → no Continue button, only Exit/Submaximal) is intact.

Nice-to-have (not blocking): the in-memory readiness answer cache (Map at module scope in src/lib/benchmark/readiness.ts) survives SPA navigation within a live JS runtime but is wiped by full page reload — which is expected behaviour and matches the spec's 'in-memory' wording. If persistence across reloads is ever desired, back it with AsyncStorage.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py L1187-1247 correctly gates every benchmark endpoint via auth (implicit through udb/_ScopedCollection using auth.current_user_id()), strips _id and user_id before returning, and validates POST payload (400 on missing testId). PATCH filters out id/user_id/_id from the update dict so a rider cannot rewrite ownership. All 4 endpoints properly return 404 for unknown ids under the current user.

backend/server.py GET /api/benchmark/profile builds the response from a whitelisted key list (9 keys), which is why every value is null for a fresh rider — the response schema is stable regardless of what's in the underlying doc.

frontend/app/benchmark/index.tsx renders 'Not yet tested' whenever profile[key] is null/undefined (has = raw !== null && raw !== undefined) — no 0 fallbacks, matching the spec that 'empty' must never look like 'tested-and-scored-zero'.

frontend/src/lib/benchmark/readiness.ts evaluateReadiness() short-circuits to 'do_not_start' the moment any DANGER question (only 'symptoms' is flagged danger:true) has a non-ideal answer, before the general 'anyBad → caution' check — this ordering is the safety gate.

frontend/app/benchmark/readiness/[id].tsx conditionally renders rd-continue ONLY when outcome === 'ready' or outcome === 'caution'; the do_not_start branch renders only rd-exit + rd-submax. Verified in DOM: rd-continue is absent from the DOM when outcome=do_not_start, not just hidden by style.
frontend/src/data.ts navItems array places benchmark at index 3 between routes (index 2) and training (index 4); navFooter keeps settings/help at the bottom.

frontend/src/lib/benchmark/api.ts createBenchmarkSession is fired from the readiness 'Check my readiness' handler (setSaving true→POST→setSaving false), and the resulting session id can be fetched later — no orphan POSTs on question-only interactions.
